stories.title: BlackRock's staking Ethereum ETF pays yield, but ETHA still gets the flows
stories.summary: BlackRock now offers a staking Ethereum ETF that pays yield to holders. Investors still favor BlackRock's existing $9 billion ETHA fund, which does not stake, CryptoSlate reported. The report did not give specific flow figures for the new staking product.
stories.whyItMatters: The gap suggests investors value simplicity and liquidity over yield, a signal for how issuers design future crypto ETFs.
whatToWatch: Weekly flow data for the staking ETF versus ETHA
Whether other issuers launch competing staking ETFs
questions: Why hasn't the staking yield pulled money out of ETHA?
Does the staking structure carry different liquidity or lockup terms?

sources.title: BlackRock’s staking Ethereum ETF pays yield but investors still prefer its $9 billion ETHA fund

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $463M in weekly reversal as Ether ETFs gain $197M
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $463 million in net outflows over the past week, reversing a prior trend, Cointelegraph reported. Spot Ether ETFs moved the other way, taking in $197 million over the same period.
stories.whyItMatters: The split shows capital rotating between the two largest crypto ETF categories, a read on institutional sentiment toward each asset.
whatToWatch: Next week's flow data to see if the divergence continues
Whether Bitcoin outflows persist or reverse again
questions: What drove the rotation out of Bitcoin ETFs and into Ether ETFs?

stories.title: Strategy buys back $139M of STRC as its bitcoin stack stays frozen a second week
stories.summary: Strategy repurchased $139 million of its STRC preferred shares, Decrypt reported. The company's bitcoin holdings did not change for a second straight week.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin holder, so a pause in purchases alongside a buyback of its own paper is a signal worth tracking.
whatToWatch: Whether Strategy resumes bitcoin purchases next week
Further STRC buyback activity
questions: Why has Strategy paused new bitcoin buys?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $463M as Fed decision puts $75,000 support at risk
stories.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $463 million in net outflows this week. CryptoSlate said an upcoming Fed decision could pressure bitcoin's price down toward the $75,000 level. The outflow figure matches other reports; this framing ties it to the Fed.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed policy remains a major driver of risk-asset flows, and a break below key support would matter for leveraged positions across the market.
whatToWatch: The Fed's upcoming decision and statement
Whether bitcoin holds the $75,000 level
questions: How much of the outflow reflects pre-positioning for the Fed versus other factors?

stories.title: Bitmine projects $334M in annual staking revenue from its $15.8B crypto treasury
stories.summary: Bitmine says its crypto treasury, now valued at $15.8 billion, could generate $334 million a year in staking revenue, Cointelegraph reported. The figure is a company projection, not a realized result.
stories.whyItMatters: Large corporate crypto treasuries increasingly lean on staking yield, a trend that affects how much crypto supply gets locked up versus traded.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitmine's actual staking revenue matches its projection
Changes in the size of the treasury
questions: What assumptions underlie the $334 million projection?

stories.title: Trump backs tougher ethics rules in the Clarity Act as industry bets on passage
stories.summary: President Trump supported adding stricter ethics provisions to the Clarity Act, Decrypt reported. Crypto industry figures reportedly believe the added rules improve the bill's chances of passing.
stories.whyItMatters: The Clarity Act would set core market-structure rules for crypto in the US, so its provisions and momentum toward passage directly affect regulatory certainty for the industry.
whatToWatch: Next legislative steps or votes on the Clarity Act
Full details of the ethics provisions Trump backed
questions: What specific ethics rules were added, and who do they apply to?
Does the White House's support translate into congressional votes?

stories.title: Fragmented rules limit stablecoin use in global finance, says WTO head
stories.summary: The head of the World Trade Organization said fragmented regulations across countries are limiting stablecoin adoption in international finance, Cointelegraph reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Cross-border regulatory alignment is a prerequisite for stablecoins to scale in trade and payments, so comments from a body like the WTO carry weight.
whatToWatch: Any WTO or multilateral effort to harmonize stablecoin rules
How individual countries' stablecoin frameworks develop
questions: Which specific jurisdictions create the biggest friction?

stories.title: UK FCA seeks feedback on fund rule exemptions for tokenized gold
stories.summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority opened a consultation on exempting tokenized gold from certain fund rules, Cointelegraph reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Fund-rule exemptions would make it easier for regulated UK funds to hold tokenized gold, expanding institutional access to tokenized commodities.
whatToWatch: The deadline and outcome of the FCA's consultation
Whether other tokenized commodities get similar treatment
questions: What specific rules would be exempted, and for which fund types?

stories.summary: Analyst Alice Liu said HYPE's price could come under pressure as Binance captures some of its revenue, Cointelegraph reported. This is an analyst's view, not a confirmed market outcome.
stories.whyItMatters: Competition between exchanges over trading and product revenue can squeeze the tokenomics of exchange-linked assets like HYPE.

questions: How exactly does Binance capture HYPE-linked revenue?

stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's behavior relative to a broader equity selloff tests whether it trades as a risk asset or a hedge under stress.

Whether $78,000 holds as support

stories.title: Leveraged funds rebuild 1,669 BTC of futures shorts ahead of Fed decision
stories.summary: Leveraged funds added back 1,669 BTC worth of bitcoin futures short positions heading into the Fed's decision, CryptoSlate reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Rebuilt short positioning ahead of a major macro event points to hedging or bearish bets that can amplify price swings if the Fed surprises markets.

Whether shorts get covered or extended afterward
questions: Is this positioning a hedge or a directional bearish bet?

stories.title: Another public company exits its bitcoin treasury, selling the last 764 BTC
stories.summary: A public company sold its remaining 764 BTC, ending its bitcoin treasury strategy, CryptoSlate reported. The report gave no further detail on the company's reasoning beyond the sale.
stories.whyItMatters: Corporate bitcoin treasuries have been a steady source of demand, so a company exiting the strategy is a signal worth watching.
whatToWatch: Whether other public companies follow with treasury exits
Any statement from the company on its reasoning
questions: Why did the company abandon its bitcoin treasury strategy?
